problem_restatement: Verify that the v52 incremental asset-ledger reader and the compatible-checkpoint boundary cache remove repeated O(history) work without changing live execution, losing telemetry, or accepting ledger replacement, truncation, or boundary mutation.

root_causes.cause: Each telemetry snapshot reparsed complete append-only asset ledgers rather than consuming a validated suffix.
root_causes.repair: Initialize compatible history once, then use an exact byte and sequence cursor with fail-closed truncation, torn-suffix, sequence-drift, and second-writer checks.

root_causes.cause: Every checkpoint refresh searched each active ledger from byte zero for the earliest compatible execution identity, rereading about 2.08 GB per refresh at the measured v52 boundary.
root_causes.repair: Cache the exact compatible boundary in process and reuse it only after device, inode, monotonic size, boundary-row hash, and execution-identity validation.

red_failures_reproduced: zero-offset boundary omitted observed byte count
tdd.green_contract: All reproduced failures now reject or expose the required provenance; the scoped test suites pass.
tdd.lint_and_format: Ruff check and Ruff format --check passed; git diff --check passed on the checkpoint snapshot implementation and tests.

same_process_read_only_benchmark.interpretation: The first call proves the boundary once; the warm call validates and skips the historical prefixes. This is a local read-only measurement, not a latency SLA.

uncertainties_and_failure_modes: The v52 run has no fills or completed lifecycle, so fill, fee, funding, markout, stop, target, and exit projections have not yet been exercised under the deployed implementation.
One hour of stable operation does not establish bounded memory over days or weeks.
Process RSS and native physical-footprint tools use different accounting and must not be compared as if they were the same metric.
A device or inode reuse edge case is additionally guarded by the boundary-row hash and execution identity, but only a real mutation event can exercise that live.
falsifiers: Any compatible v52 fill, fee, funding, markout, book, position, or exit missing from the checkpoint.
Any warm refresh reporting source_start_offset_cache_hit=false without a source replacement, truncation, or publisher restart.
Checkpoint duration or memory returning to growth proportional to historical ledger size.
A replaced, truncated, sequence-drifting, or boundary-mutated ledger being accepted.
A backend cycle delay, runtime fault, or unmanaged lifecycle attributable to telemetry projection.

recommendation.recommendation: Retain the deployed incremental readers and continue measuring them through the first exact v52 lifecycle.
recommendation.why_now: The measured O(history) work was material and the v52 process provides the first live opportunity to validate the repaired path without carrying a v51 position.
recommendation.evidence_reviewed: Source trace, red-green tests, scoped and expanded suites, local warm-cache benchmark, exact running profile identity, live process health, poll cadence, cache provenance, and checkpoint-to-ledger evidence.
recommendation.observed_problem_or_opportunity: Remove avoidable infrastructure contention so signal evaluation, exits, and operator telemetry remain timely as ledgers grow.
recommendation.applicable_market_regime: All regimes; the change is infrastructure-only.
recommendation.alternatives_considered: Retain full rescans, reduce telemetry frequency, truncate history, restart the live backend, or validate exact incremental boundaries.
recommendation.proposed_live_change: None. The live strategy, asset universe, route parameters, sizing, leverage, risk, and execution behavior remain unchanged.
recommendation.expected_upside: Lower checkpoint I/O and bounded backend projection work, reducing the chance of observability contention or delayed lifecycle management.
recommendation.main_risks_and_failure_modes: False cache reuse, hidden projection omission, long-run memory growth, source replacement, or mixed identity.
recommendation.validation_completed: TDD, 69-test expanded checkpoint suite, lint/format checks, exact live identity reconciliation, warm-cache benchmark, and multiple fresh warm-cache checkpoints.
recommendation.validation_still_required: First compatible v52 entry and completed lifecycle, followed by exact fill/cost/funding/exit reconciliation and multi-day resource observation.
recommendation.success_metrics: No missing execution evidence, warm cache hits on unchanged ledgers, bounded checkpoint refresh work, stable backend cycles, and fail-closed source mutation handling.
recommendation.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any falsifier above; stop the report-only publisher if it creates contention, while leaving the live backend and venue protection untouched.
recommendation.confidence_level: high on the root causes and deployed cache behavior; medium-high on operational benefit; low on long-run resource bounds until more elapsed time and a full lifecycle are observed

highest_value_next_investigation.reason: The technical projection path is accepted provisionally; exact HYPE both-side lifecycle economics and BTC route occupancy remain the highest-value unresolved evidence.
